chat.author: Igor Lubashev
chat.text: Anton, this is Intera-Domain.  In this case, the customer does not connect via BGP at all.  The provider announces the IPs for the customer, who may just rents a set of servers in the provider's datacenter.

chat.author: Kotikalapudi Sriram
chat.text: Antoin: Regarding your question about the more specific prefixes in the ROA, they are there just in case the prefix user wishes to withdraw the less specific in the future and wants to announce one or both more specific prefixes instead.
